Mean of the twelve tile probabilities
p(patient) = (1/12) Σ p(tile)
= 9.31 / 12 = 0.78

div.div:
Eleven of the twelve fields point to anaemia and one does not. Because the threshold is applied to the mean
rather than to each field, a single blurred or sparsely populated tile cannot determine the outcome alone.
